entries.title: A sign-in for a program on your computer finishes on the first try
entries.body: When you sign in for a program on your computer in a crewmate's browser and the sign-in ends on that program's own address, the browser now opens it, so the program gets your sign-in the first time. A website still cannot reach programs on your computer behind your back, and if the browser does refuse a page, it says why and your crewmate learns what to do.

picture.alt: A task's browser on a program's address on this computer, the program's page saying it is signed in while the captain holds the browser
